description: Route-2 acquisition cold_email->referral: the one decision field neither v1 nor v2 ever moved or listed in a catalog. Route 2 is market-capped at 62.5 clients under BOTH channels, but referral converts ~8x better per prospect-hour (3 prospects/hr x 12% vs 35/hr x 0.23%), so it reaches the same cap with ~313 acquisition hours instead of ~1392. Revenue is unchanged; ~1079 fewer productive hours means ~35 kEUR less opportunity cost. Expect a large KEEP that falsifies v2's 'all levers confirmed at optimum'.

Route-1 build price 1200->1225: v2 probed only UPWARD (1200->1500) and concluded 'the floor is optimal'. Route-1 revenue is clients(pb) x (pb + care_rev), a downward parabola in pb whose vertex sits at ~1227, just ABOVE the 1200 declared floor. Expect a KEEP that is numerically real but commercially meaningless, falsifying the word 'floor' while leaving 'loss-lead the build' intact.
